description: This file defines the EmployeeAttachmentModel class in the OrangeHRM project, specifically within the API model namespace for employee attachments. It models the data structure for employee attachment entities, including metadata such as ID, description, filename, size, file type, and uploader information, intended for serialization and API responses.

classes.name: EmployeeAttachmentModel
classes.description: A model class implementing serialization of employee attachment data for API responses, utilizing traits for common serialization functionality, and constructed with a PartialEmployeeAttachment DTO.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with a PartialEmployeeAttachment object and sets up filters and attribute mappings for serialization.
